cache_condition: same-process warmed; warmup before each L/method; no cache flushing

cost.exact_GT_reason: Audited existing GT reused; this task did not compute exact GT

definition.portals: Two distinct in-region base IDs with highest occurrence count in fit GT10; ties use ascending base ID. No pilot labels or probe optimization.
definition.region_profiles: Sum normalized fit queries weighted by their GT10 fraction in region; normalize resulting vector. Only fit rows10000:30000.

routing_mac_definition: one MAC per dimension per routing distance; excludes norm/softmax/scheduling scalar operations, which remain timed
